note: Sample editable templates generated by scripts/build-assets.js. Not verified official government formats.

templates.name: Standard Letter (English)
templates.description: General-purpose letter on a text letterhead built from the College Profile. Replace it with your own letterhead under Templates → "Use as letterhead".

templates.name: Standard Letter (Marathi)
templates.description: सर्वसाधारण पत्र – मराठी मांडणी (जा. क्र., दिनांक, प्रति, विषय, संदर्भ).

templates.name: BEO – Student information submission
templates.subject: Submission of student information for the academic year
templates.body:
With reference to the above subject, we are submitting herewith the information of the students of our institution for the current academic year as required by your office.
The details have been verified with the school records. Kindly accept the same and acknowledge receipt.

templates.name: UDISE – S02 new student record request (covering letter)
templates.subject: Request to create UDISE+ student profile (Form S02)
templates.body:
The profiles of the following student(s) of our institution have not yet been created in the UDISE+ Student Module (SDMS). The students were searched in the Global Search module and no existing profile was found.
The duly filled Form S02 for {{student_count}} student(s), along with an attested copy of the School / Admission Register and other supporting documents, is enclosed herewith.
Kindly approve the creation of the student profile(s) at the earliest.

templates.name: UDISE – S02 नवीन विद्यार्थी नोंद (मराठी)
templates.subject: UDISE+ प्रणालीमध्ये विद्यार्थ्यांची नवीन नोंद (फॉर्म S02) करण्याबाबत.
templates.body:
सविनय अर्ज आहे की, आमच्या महाविद्यालयातील खालील विद्यार्थ्यांची नावे UDISE+ प्रणालीमध्ये अद्याप प्रविष्ट झालेली नाहीत. Global Search मध्ये शोध घेतला असता त्यांची कोणतीही नोंद आढळली नाही.
विद्यार्थ्यांचे भरलेले फॉर्म S02 व जनरल रजिस्टरचा साक्षांकित उतारा सोबत जोडला आहे. तरी कृपया विद्यार्थ्यांची नोंद करण्यास मान्यता द्यावी, ही विनंती.

templates.name: UDISE – S03 correction request (covering letter)
templates.subject: Request to update details of active student(s) in UDISE+ (Form S03)
templates.body:
Some details of the following active student(s) recorded in UDISE+ do not match the school records. The existing and corrected details are shown in the enclosed Form S03 for {{student_count}} student(s).
Copies of the School Register and Birth Certificate are attached for verification. Kindly approve the correction in UDISE+.

templates.name: Student name correction (as per Aadhaar)
templates.subject: Request for correction of student name as per Aadhaar card
templates.body:
The name of the student mentioned below has been recorded incorrectly. As per the Aadhaar card and the General Register of our institution, the correct name is given below.
Student name (as recorded): ______
Correct name (as per Aadhaar / G.R.): ______
The necessary documents are enclosed. Kindly do the needful.

templates.name: विद्यार्थी नाव दुरुस्ती – आधार प्रमाणे (मराठी)
templates.subject: विद्यार्थ्याचे नाव आधार कार्डप्रमाणे दुरुस्त करण्याबाबत.
templates.body:
सविनय अर्ज आहे की, खालील विद्यार्थ्याचे नाव चुकीचे नोंदविले गेले आहे. आधार कार्ड व जनरल रजिस्टरप्रमाणे योग्य नाव खाली दिले आहे.
नोंदलेले नाव: ______
योग्य नाव (आधारप्रमाणे): ______
आवश्यक कागदपत्रे सोबत जोडली आहेत. तरी योग्य ती कार्यवाही करावी, ही विनंती.

templates.name: Student date of birth correction
templates.subject: Request for correction of date of birth of student
templates.body:
The date of birth of the student mentioned below has been recorded incorrectly. As per the birth certificate and the General Register of our institution, the correct date of birth is given below.
Student name: ______
Date of birth recorded: ______
Correct date of birth: ______
Attested copies of the birth certificate and General Register extract are enclosed.

templates.name: HSC Board – mark memo collection
templates.subject: Request for issue of HSC mark memos (statement of marks)
templates.body:
We request you to kindly issue the mark memos (statements of marks) of the H.S.C. examination for the candidates of our junior college. Our authorised representative will collect the documents from the Divisional Board office.
College details: {{college_name}}, Index No. {{index_no}}, UDISE {{udise_code}}.

templates.name: HSC Board – passing certificate collection
templates.subject: Request for issue of HSC passing certificates
templates.body: We request you to kindly issue the H.S.C. passing certificates of the successful candidates of our junior college. Our authorised representative will collect the certificates from your office. The authority letter of the representative is enclosed.

templates.name: 12th examination – preliminary form list submission
templates.subject: Submission of pre-list of candidates appearing for the H.S.C. examination
templates.body: We are submitting herewith the pre-list of the candidates of our junior college who will appear for the forthcoming H.S.C. examination. The list has been checked with the college records and the candidates' details have been verified.

templates.name: Examination fee submission
templates.subject: Submission of H.S.C. examination fees
templates.body: We are submitting herewith the examination fees of the candidates of our junior college for the forthcoming H.S.C. examination. The challan / payment details and the list of candidates are enclosed.

templates.name: Teacher and invigilator details submission
templates.subject: Submission of details of teachers for invigilation / moderation work
templates.body: As required, we are submitting the details of the teachers of our junior college available for invigilation, paper assessment and moderation work for the forthcoming H.S.C. examination. The teachers will be relieved for the assigned duty as per the schedule.

templates.name: Practical examination marks submission
templates.subject: Submission of practical / oral examination marks
templates.body: We are submitting herewith the marks of the practical / oral examinations of the H.S.C. candidates of our junior college. The mark lists have been checked and are signed by the internal and external examiners.

templates.name: Practical examination papers submission
templates.subject: Submission of practical examination answer books / journals
templates.body: We are submitting the sealed packets of the practical examination answer books and related records of the candidates of our junior college as per the instructions of the Board.

templates.name: General administrative information submission
templates.subject: Submission of information
templates.body: With reference to the above subject, the information requested by your office is submitted herewith in the prescribed format. Kindly accept the same.
